   "source": [
    "# Databases - Laboratory"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "db7d85fc",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "This tutorial covers `LabDB`, the database for water samples analysed in a laboratory. Data follows a chain:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **sites**: places where field work happens, as points;\n",
    "2. **samples**: bottles collected at a site, at a sampling time;\n",
    "3. **mixtures**: what the lab actually analyses, usually one sample alone, sometimes a blend of several;\n",
    "4. **records**: one result per mixture and parameter, at an analysis time.\n",
    "\n",
    "The example is a river monitoring program with four sampling points and four campaigns, analysed for turbidity, pH and sodium.\n",
    "\n",
    "```{seealso}\n",
    "Check out the {doc}`Databases - Spatial <databases_03_spatial>` tutorial first.\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "13d46fb1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Notebook setup\n",
    "\n",
    "For users running this tutorial as a Jupyter Notebook, this cell must be executed first:"

  },

    "import sys\n",
    "import json\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import geopandas as gpd\n",
    "\n",
    "# Install `plans` in `google.colab`.\n",
    "# Use `pip install plans` for other environments.\n",
    "\n",
    "if \"google.colab\" in sys.modules:\n",
    "    import os\n",
    "    os.system(f\"{sys.executable} -m pip install -q plans\")\n",
    "\n",
    "from plans.databases import LabDB\n",
    "\n",
    "# This avoids warnings related to uninstalled fonts\n",
    "import logging\n",
    "# Set the matplotlib font manager logger to only show errors (hides warnings)\n",
    "logging.getLogger('matplotlib.font_manager').setLevel(logging.ERROR)\n",
    "\n",
    "# define output folder\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR = Path(\"outputs/databases\")\n",
    "OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "print(f\"Outputs will be saved to: ./{OUTPUT_DIR}\")"
   ]
  },
  {

   "id": "c9c6d579",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Sites and catalogs\n",
    "\n",
    "Four sampling points run from upstream (`P1`) to downstream (`P4`), below a town:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "6f7608fe",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.134168Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.133913Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.184965Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.184453Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "sites = gpd.GeoDataFrame(\n",
    "    data={\"name\": [\"P1\", \"P2\", \"P3\", \"P4\"]},\n",
    "    geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(x=[-51.30, -51.22, -51.15, -51.08], y=[-29.90, -29.95, -30.02, -30.05]),\n",
    "    crs=\"EPSG:4674\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "file_sites = OUTPUT_DIR / \"lab_sites.gpkg\"\n",
    "sites.to_file(filename=file_sites, driver=\"GPKG\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "0e096c7d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The specs point to the variables `turbidity`, `ph` and `sodium (physical-chemistry)`, all with the `instant` statistic, since each result is a single analysis, not an aggregate. The sources catalog that ships with `plans` has no laboratory, so the setup points to a custom one. Any catalog can be replaced this way:"

  },

    "file_sources = OUTPUT_DIR / \"lab_sources.csv\"\n",
    "pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "    [{\"name\": \"River Survey\", \"alias\": \"RS\", \"title\": \"River monitoring program\", \"abstract\": \"Synthetic campaigns\", \"citation\": None, \"url\": None}]\n",
    ").to_csv(file_sources, sep=\";\", index=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def make_spec(name, variable, abstract):\n",
    "    # one spec of lab results\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        \"name\": name,\n",
    "        \"abstract\": abstract,\n",
    "        \"method\": \"laboratory analysis\",\n",
    "        \"timestep\": \"event\",\n",
    "        \"extent\": \"sample\",\n",
    "        \"scale\": 1,\n",
    "        \"offset\": 0,\n",
    "        \"start\": \"2024-01-01\",\n",
    "        \"end\": None,\n",
    "        \"variable_name\": variable,\n",
    "        \"statistic_name\": \"instant\",\n",
    "        \"source_name\": \"River Survey\",\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "specs = [\n",
    "    make_spec(\"TURB_LAB\", \"turbidity\", \"Turbidity by nephelometry\"),\n",
    "    make_spec(\"PH_LAB\", \"ph\", \"pH by electrode, in triplicate\"),\n",
    "    make_spec(\"NA_LAB\", \"sodium (physical-chemistry)\", \"Dissolved sodium by ion chromatography\"),\n",
    "]\n",
    "file_specs = OUTPUT_DIR / \"lab_specs.json\"\n",
    "file_specs.write_text(json.dumps(specs, indent=2), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",
    "\n",
    "db = LabDB(name=\"River Lab\")\n",
    "db.new(\n",
    "    config={\n",
    "        \"database\": {\"path\": str(OUTPUT_DIR / \"lab_db.gpkg\")},\n",
    "        \"specs\": {\"path\": str(file_specs)},\n",
    "        \"spatial\": {\"file\": str(file_sites)},\n",
    "        \"catalogs\": {\"sources\": str(file_sources)},\n",
    "    },\n",
    "    overwrite=True,\n",
    ")\n",
    "db.query_sql(sql=\"SELECT name, units, domain FROM variables WHERE name IN ('turbidity', 'ph', 'sodium (physical-chemistry)')\")"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "campaigns = {\"C1\": \"2024-02-10\", \"C2\": \"2024-05-12\", \"C3\": \"2024-08-14\", \"C4\": \"2024-11-09\"}\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for campaign, day in campaigns.items():\n",
    "    for k, site in enumerate(sites[\"name\"]):\n",
    "        time = \"12:00\" if (campaign, site) == (\"C3\", \"P2\") else f\"{8 + k}:30\"\n",
    "        rows.append({\"name\": f\"{campaign}-{site}\", \"site_name\": site, \"datetime\": f\"{day} {time}\"})\n",
    "samples = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
    "db.insert_samples(dataframe=samples)\n",
    "db.query_sql(sql=\"SELECT id, name, datetime(datetime, 'unixepoch') AS datetime, site_id FROM samples LIMIT 5\")"
   ]
  },

    "## Mixtures\n",
    "\n",
    "Usually the lab analyses each bottle alone. Without a `name` column, `.insert_mixtures()` makes one mixture per sample, named after it. In the last campaign, the bottles of `P3` and `P4` were half empty, so the lab blended them into one mixture. A blend takes one row per sample, with the same mixture name:"

   "source": [
    "single = samples.loc[~samples[\"name\"].isin([\"C4-P3\", \"C4-P4\"]), [\"name\"]]\n",
    "db.insert_mixtures(dataframe=single.rename(columns={\"name\": \"sample_name\"}))\n",
    "db.insert_mixtures(dataframe=pd.DataFrame({\"name\": \"C4-P34\", \"sample_name\": [\"C4-P3\", \"C4-P4\"]}))\n",
    "db.query_sql(\n",
    "    sql=\"SELECT m.name AS mixture, s.name AS sample FROM mixtures m \"\n",
    "    \"JOIN mixture_samples ms ON ms.mixture_id = m.id JOIN samples s ON s.id = ms.sample_id \"\n",
    "    \"WHERE m.name LIKE 'C4%'\"\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },

    "## Results\n",
    "\n",

   "source": [
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=11)  # ensure reproducibility\n",
    "mixtures = db.query_sql(sql=\"SELECT id, name FROM mixtures\")\n",
    "results = []\n",
    "for mixture in mixtures[\"name\"]:\n",
    "    campaign = mixture[:2]\n",
    "    position = int(mixture[-1]) - 1  # 0 upstream to 3 downstream\n",
    "    wet = campaign in (\"C2\", \"C3\")\n",
    "    analysis = None if campaign == \"C3\" else pd.Timestamp(campaigns[campaign]) + pd.Timedelta(days=int(rng.integers(2, 6)))\n",
    "    turbidity = (8 + 10 * position) * (1.8 if wet else 1) * rng.lognormal(sigma=0.2)\n",
    "    sodium = 0.2 + 3 * position + rng.normal(scale=0.3)\n",
    "    results.append({\"mixture_name\": mixture, \"parameter\": \"TURB_LAB\", \"value\": turbidity, \"datetime\": analysis})\n",
    "    results.append({\"mixture_name\": mixture, \"parameter\": \"NA_LAB\", \"value\": sodium, \"datetime\": analysis})\n",
    "    for _ in range(3):\n",
    "        ph = 7.4 - 0.25 * position + rng.normal(scale=0.05)\n",
    "        results.append({\"mixture_name\": mixture, \"parameter\": \"PH_LAB\", \"value\": round(ph, 2), \"datetime\": analysis})\n",
    "results = pd.DataFrame(results)\n",
    "results.head(6)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2c2213dd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Sodium has a detection limit of 0.5 mg/L. Results below it are *not detected*: they get the `nondetect` flag (`-3`) and keep the limit as their value. All other results are `regular` (`1`). With mixed flags, the flag goes in a `flag_value` column instead of the `flag` argument:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "8129449d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.419974Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.419804Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.453746Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.453013Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "3 sodium results not detected\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "lod = 0.5\n",
    "results[\"flag_value\"] = 1\n",
    "below = (results[\"parameter\"] == \"NA_LAB\") & (results[\"value\"] < lod)\n",
    "results.loc[below, [\"value\", \"flag_value\"]] = [lod, -3]\n",
    "print(f\"{below.sum()} sodium results not detected\")\n",
    "\n",
    "for spec_name, group in results.groupby(\"parameter\"):\n",
    "    db.insert_records(dataframe=group.drop(columns=\"parameter\"), spec_name=spec_name)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "d5bdc31a",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "2466159d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Filters by site match every mixture that holds a sample from it, so the blend of the last campaign shows up under both `P3` and `P4`:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "f2c99a91",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.469961Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.469741Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.480676Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.480228Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "P3 ['C1-P3', 'C2-P3', 'C3-P3', 'C4-P34']\n",
      "P4 ['C1-P4', 'C2-P4', 'C3-P4', 'C4-P34']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "names = db.query_sql(sql=\"SELECT id, name FROM mixtures\").set_index(\"id\")[\"name\"]\n",
    "for site in [\"P3\", \"P4\"]:\n",
    "    df = db.query_records(query_dict={\"spec_name\": \"TURB_LAB\", \"site_name\": site})\n",
    "    print(site, names[df[\"mixture_id\"]].tolist())"
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9974e17d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Storage time\n",
    "\n",
    "The gap between sampling and analysis is how long the bottle waited. It should not affect results; a long wait can point to problems in storage. Unknown analysis times stay empty:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "id": "d02d595d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.496326Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.496136Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.505850Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.505415Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "mixture_id\n",
       "C1-P1     1.6\n",
       "C1-P2     1.6\n",
       "C1-P3     1.6\n",
       "C1-P4     3.5\n",
       "C2-P1     2.6\n",
       "C2-P2     3.6\n",
       "C2-P3     4.6\n",
       "C2-P4     4.5\n",
       "C3-P1     NaN\n",
       "C3-P2     NaN\n",
       "C3-P3     NaN\n",
       "C3-P4     NaN\n",
       "C4-P1     3.6\n",
       "C4-P2     3.6\n",
       "C4-P34    4.5\n",
       "Name: storage_days, dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 11,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "df = db.query_records(query_dict={\"spec_name\": \"PH_LAB\"})\n",
    "df[\"storage_days\"] = (df[\"datetime\"] - df[\"sample_datetime\"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400\n",
    "df.groupby(\"mixture_id\")[\"storage_days\"].first().rename(index=names).round(1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5527231d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Replicates and censored values\n",
    "\n",
    "The three pH readings of a mixture are identical in time and place. They are valid replicates, not duplicates, and only the record id tells them apart. The wide format refuses them unless an `aggfunc` combines them. Each mixture then gets one column, with a single value at its sampling time:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "id": "3095c57d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.508719Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.508558Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.516593Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-06T21:03:18.516122Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "15 replicated entries, eg: ['PH_LAB / 1 at 2024-02-10 08:30:00+00:00 has 3 values', 'PH_LAB / 2 at 2024-02-10 09:30:00+00:00 has 3 values', 'PH_LAB / 3 at 2024-02-10 10:30:00+00:00 has 3 values']; pass aggfunc to aggregate\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "try:\n",
    "    db.query_records(query_dict={\"spec_name\": \"PH_LAB\", \"wide\": True})\n",
    "except ValueError as error:\n",
    "    print(error)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "ph = db.query_records(query_dict={\"spec_name\": \"PH_LAB\", \"wide\": True, \"aggfunc\": \"mean\"})\n",

   "source": [
    "samples_sites = db.query_sql(\n",
    "    sql=\"SELECT ms.mixture_id, si.name AS site FROM mixture_samples ms \"\n",
    "    \"JOIN samples sa ON sa.id = ms.sample_id JOIN sites si ON si.id = sa.site_id\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "df = db.query_records(query_dict={\"spec_name\": \"NA_LAB\"}).merge(samples_sites, on=\"mixture_id\")\n",
    "pd.DataFrame(\n",
    "    {\n",
    "        \"all records\": df.groupby(\"site\")[\"value\"].mean(),\n",
    "        \"regular only\": df[df[\"flag_value\"] == 1].groupby(\"site\")[\"value\"].mean(),\n",
    "        \"not detected\": df[df[\"flag_value\"] == -3].groupby(\"site\")[\"value\"].count(),\n",
    "    }\n",
    ").round(2)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3))\n",
    "df[\"campaign\"] = names[df[\"mixture_id\"]].str[:2].values\n",
    "for campaign, group in df.groupby(\"campaign\"):\n",
    "    group = group.sort_values(\"site\")\n",
    "    ax.plot(group[\"site\"], group[\"value\"], marker=\"o\", label=campaign)\n",
    "ax.axhline(lod, color=\"gray\", ls=\"--\", lw=0.8)\n",
    "ax.text(0, lod + 0.2, \"detection limit\", color=\"gray\", fontsize=8)\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Sodium (mg/L)\")\n",
    "ax.legend(frameon=False)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
